question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.

This will sound weired, but bear with me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"weird"** means something that is strange or unusual. (अजीब)

 
 
• **Example: **She had a weird feeling that she was being watched.
 
 
 
• **"Wired"** refers to being equipped with wires or connected via wiring, often used in the context of electronic devices. (तारों से लैस)
 
 
• **Example: **The office is fully wired for high-speed internet.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wired** (तारों से लैस): Equipped with wires or connected via wiring.

 
 
• **Example:** The security system is wired to the main control room.
 
 
 
• **Beer** (बीयर): An alcoholic drink made from yeast-fermented malt flavored with hops.
 
 
• **Example:** They enjoyed a cold beer after the long hike.
 
 
 
• **Bier** (अर्थी): A stand on which a corpse or coffin is placed.
 
 
• **Example:** The bier was set in the center of the room for the viewing.
